title: Change request call with a Riyadh trading client, Arabic-accented English

brief.title: CR-07 call with Faisal
brief.goals: Agree the change request for Arabic invoices; confirm the timeline
brief.instructions: Polite and clear. Do not promise dates we did not agree.

documents.title: Contract notes
documents.text: Odoo 17 ERP integration with the warehouse system; phase 1 delivered October 2025. Support: 2 visits a month. Change request CR-07: Arabic invoices with the e-invoicing QR code. Estimate: 32,000 riyals, 4 weeks.

events.text: Wa alaikum assalam Adeel. So, the new invoices, the Arabic ones, you finished the estimate?
events.reference:
Yes: 32,000 riyals and 4 weeks for CR-07.
- **Scope**: Arabic invoices with the QR code

events.text: Okay. For this change request we approved 35,000 riyal, not more than this.

facts: Them: 35,000 SAR approved for CR-07, not more (minute 2)

events.text: Our go-live must be before Ramadan, this is very important for us.
You can do it with the same team from phase one?
events.reference:
Yes, the same team that delivered phase 1.
- **Why**: they know your Odoo 17 setup

bad.answer: Yes, we are a certified partner, so it is easy for us.

events.text: Okay, I will tell the finance team to prepare the PO.

bad.answer: Thank you very much, Mr Faisal.

events.text: And the support visits, how many in the month we have?
events.reference:
2 visits a month in the support contract.
- **CR-07**: testing can use those visits

events.text: Sorry, how many weeks you said for the CR?
So we are inside the 35 thousand, yes?
events.reference: Yes, 32,000 riyals, inside the 35,000 you approved.

bad.answer: It may go to 40,000 with testing.

events.text: Good. You need anything from our side?
events.reference:
Two things.
- **Samples**: two current invoices in Arabic
- **Access**: a test login for Odoo

bad.answer: When do you need the go-live?
